text: Avatar. In Hindu mythology, the name used to signify each of the ten incarnations of Vishnu. Vishnu became specially prominent in later Brahmanism for his incarnations. These were not THEOPHANIES (q.v.), nor demi-gods, but men in whom the god was actually present. The doctrine is that of a theanthropos. But the rich mythology has included beasts and monstrosities among the Avatars. Literature : BARTH, Religions of India, 170; HOPKINS, Religions of India, 468. ( R.M.W .)
